subject: arcadeCabinet
pitch:
Category: Object.
Subject: 1980s arcade cabinet.
Style: synthwave.

requests.what: Add a slim synthwave light bar across the cabinet roof: a dark violet housing, six chunky lamps alternating CYAN and MAGENTA, and two small angled brackets. Keep it blocky and toy-like.
Build a raised 1980s arcade title emblem on the marquee: layered hot-pink and cyan beveled lettering or a bold angular starburst badge, with a thin dark outline and two tiny corner bolts.

Add the control hardware on the deck: one tall black joystick with a MAGENTA ball, a cyan collar, a square mounting plate, and six large alternating CYAN and MAGENTA arcade buttons. Leave a readable gap around every control.
Add a centered speaker grille beneath the marquee: a dark inset rectangle, two rows of evenly spaced short slits, cyan end caps, and four small silver screws.
Add a coin-door badge and fittings: a small gold octagonal token emblem, two cyan coin return slots, a magenta service light, and four silver corner rivets.

Add a recessed CRT screen treatment: a thin violet inner rim, three subtle cyan scanline strips, and a small magenta reflection diamond in the upper corner. Keep the center of the screen mostly clear.

Add a synthwave side-panel rail on the visible left side: stepped MAGENTA and CYAN neon strips following the cabinet's front edge, with three dark mounting blocks. Keep the large center of the side panel open.
Add a low front ventilation grille: a black inset, seven short cyan slats, two magenta end brackets, and a tiny gold power indicator.
Add a short coiled power cable emerging from the rear lower panel, using BLACK, VIOLET, and CYAN bands, plus a small rectangular strain-relief block. Keep it close to the cabinet footprint.

Paint the marquee face as a saturated synthwave gradient from deep PURPLE at the bottom to MAGENTA and CYAN at the top, with a subtle angular grid and starburst highlights. Preserve a clean central area for the raised title emblem.

Paint the CRT screen with a dark NAVY-to-PURPLE glass field, a soft CYAN horizon glow, sparse MAGENTA pixel sparks, and restrained horizontal scanlines. Keep it readable as a blank screen behind the added reflection.

Paint the left side panel with a bold 1980s synthwave composition: BLACK and NAVY base, a large hot-pink sunset disk low toward the rear, cyan perspective grid lines, and a few angular violet speed streaks. Keep the outer neon rail unobscured.
Paint the right side panel to match the left: BLACK and NAVY base, MAGENTA sunset disk, CYAN horizon grid, and VIOLET geometric streaks, mirrored in spirit but not mechanically copied.

Paint the control deck with a dark PURPLE surface, a cyan perimeter pinstripe, small magenta directional arrows, and a sparse checker motif around the controls. Do not cover the joystick and button clearances.
